askTheOwner.purpose: A deadpan permission-slip joke about retaining your own work, with a real path to start a project.
askTheOwner.production: Built-in Codex ImageGen, followed by an uncropped square feed edition and a portrait edition.
askTheOwner.prompt: Original 4:5 portrait feed ad for App Composer and the release Who Keeps the Map?. Make it look like a genuine one-minute handwritten sign photographed neatly face on, white ordinary A4 paper filling almost all of the image, thin warm charcoal desk visible at the very edge. In blue ballpoint, sparse thick uppercase casual handwriting. Layout: first large heading 'PERMISSION TO KEEP YOUR MAP'. A simple drawn little folded trail map with a winding line and X in the centre, a diagonally drawn small arrow pointing from the words 'ASK THE OWNER' down to a handwritten signature line. On the signature line, in very large deadpan lettering 'THAT’S YOU.' The reveal is the signature; generous blank paper around it. At bottom in small but perfectly legible biro write exactly 'composer.loftwah.com'. No other words, objects, logos, happy doodle figures, stains, exaggerated creases, highlight, or marketing graphics. A confident real handwriting gag. Exactly reproduce the four text strings; leave clear margins on all four edges. Colour only blue ink on pure paper. The destination is the verified root domain. Keep it readable viewed at 330 px wide.
askTheOwner.charges: Per-image cost and host-side resource use were not available to this run.
